info.title: iCUE API
info.description: The Chester Gang Show's show management API. Generated from the code by `pnpm api:spec`: see docs/api/README.md. Every /api route needs the team's sign-in token.

get.summary: Whether the API is up, and its version

403.description: Only admins can do this.

post.summary: Create an account with a temporary password
post.description: **Needs:** admins. The temporary password is answered once, and never stored.

201.description: The account, and its temporary password.

400.description: The body doesn't fit the schema. Only a bad username carries a message; anything else has no body.

403.description: Only admins can do this.

post.summary: Reset a password, and sign the account out everywhere

200.description: The account, and its new temporary password.

403.description: Only admins can do this.

404.description: There's no account with that username.

400.description: The body doesn't fit the schema.

409.description: An admin can't disable their own account.

put.description: **Needs:** admins. Signs the account out everywhere, so it applies at their next sign-in.

teamSignIn.description: An access token from the team's Cognito user pool, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It lasts 5 minutes. Its `cognito:groups` claim says what the account may do, and its `username` claim who they are.

Unauthorized.description: No valid token. Answered by API Gateway, before the API runs.
